note: Both sets cover the same core facts (filter type, corner frequency 0.25 Hz at the -3 dB point, 0.0125 s time step, and Bode-plot readings at 0.01/0.10/1.00 Hz), and both contain the same conflicting pairs at 1.00 Hz (phase -75 vs -80 deg, magnitude -12 vs -12.5 dB) where the quoted numbers contradict the stated values. Set A adds a third, invented phase reading of -72 deg at 1.00 Hz and leans on the figure caption as the quote for four plot-derived values, so its quotes support the claims even less. Set B is otherwise identical but has one fewer wrong claim and better-matched quotes for the plot readings, making it the cleaner set.
remarks: Both extractions read values off the Bode plot curves, which are only approximately legible; the -80 deg and -12.5 dB claims contradict the axis labels quoted alongside them (-75 and -12), and both sets state the 1.00 Hz phase and magnitude twice with conflicting values. The figure caption is used as the quote for several plot-derived claims in both sets, which does not actually support the numeric values. Neither set captures the state-space matrix definitions (A_d = alpha, B_d = 1-alpha, C_d = alpha, D_d = 1-alpha) present on the page.
